feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day weather forecast

items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 17 June 2026 5:33am
items.description:
##Today##

Low cloud, mist/fog patches and patchy rain at first soon clearing to become fine and with sunny spells developing. Outbreaks of rain returning overnight.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 12°C and max. air temperature 18°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

1-3 later


##Wind Speed##

17


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

S or SW 15-20, decreasing 10-15 for a time later morning and early afternoon.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain and mist and very poor in fog patches at first. Hill fog to start and again overnight.


##Comments##

Nil.


##Tomorrow##

Cloudy with outbreaks of rain, heavy at times, becoming more patchy in the afternoon. Then a risk of coastal mist and fog later.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 12°C and max. air temperature 16°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

10-15, risk 20-25 on hills


##Wind Speed##

22


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

S or SW 15-20, increasing 20-25 in the afternoon.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, falling poor in mist and rain and very poor in fog. Hill fog.


##Comments##

Strong winds. Heavy rain at times.


##Friday, 19 June 2026##

Occasional rain becoming patchy later. Ongoing risk of coastal mist and fog patches.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 11°C and max. air temperature 16°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

2-6, up to 10


##Wind Speed##

18


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

S-SW 20-25, decreasing 10-15 later.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, falling poor in mist and rain and very poor in fog. Hill fog.


##Comments##

Strong winds until later.


##Saturday, 20 June 2026##

Largely dry and bright with sunny spells.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 12°C and max. air temperature 16°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

0-2


##Wind Speed##

10


##Wind Direction##

S


##Wind##

W or SW 10-15, gradually backing mainly E or SE later, but variable 10 or less at times.


##Visibility##

Mostly good. Isolated hill fog.


##Comments##

Nil.


##Sunday, 21 June 2026##

Dry and bright with some sunny spells at first, then tending to be cloudy.

0

10

Good.
